name: KSE
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" header_type="UInt32" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="6">
    <description>
      The <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kuramoto%E2%80%93Sivashinsky_equation">Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation</a>, with its range stabilized based on advice from <a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC1Mo9AoX5desRiFLW_skbEg/featured">Steffen Richters</a>.
      
      The stabilize parameter prevents the values from growing continuously. Set it to zero to see what happens without it.
      
      To increase the size of the blobs, try e.g.: dx = 0.3, timestep = 0.0005
      
      In 3D (try 32 x 32 x 32) use stabilize = -0.1.
      
      In 1D use stabilize = -0.025.
      
      Created by Dan Wills.
      
    </description>
    <rule name="KSE" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex">
      <param name="dx">
        0.500000
      </param>
      <param name="timestep">
        0.003000
      </param>
      <param name="stabilize">
        -0.050000
      </param>
      <param name="gms_weight">
        0.200000
      </param>
      <param name="lapweight">
        -1.000000
      </param>
      <param name="bilapweight">
        -1.000000
      </param>
      <param name="anorm">
        120.000000
      </param>
      <param name="apower">
        1.000000
      </param>
      <param name="wave_diffusion">
        20.000000
      </param>
      <param name="wave_damp">
        0.987000
      </param>
      <param name="wave_power">
        1.000000
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_wave">
        0.004000
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_wave_min">
        60.0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_DC_value">
        60.000000
      </param>
      <param name="wave_clamp">
        120.000000
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_a">
        -0.000100
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
        delta_a = bilapweight * bilaplacian_a + lapweight * laplacian_a + gradient_mag_squared_a * gms_weight + a * stabilize;
        a = min( anorm, anorm * pow( max( 0.0f,a + wave_to_a * (b-wave_DC_value) ) * ( 1.0f/anorm ), apower ) );
        b = wave_DC_value + clamp( sign(b-wave_DC_value) * pow( ( fabs(b-wave_DC_value) * wave_damp), wave_power ) + max( 0.0f, a-a_to_wave_min ) * a_to_wave, -wave_clamp, wave_clamp);
        delta_c = (laplacian_b) * wave_diffusion;
        delta_b = c + delta_c;
      </formula>
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false" zero_first="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="65" high="120">
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
        </everywhere>
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1">
      </surface_color>
      <colormap value="inferno">
      </colormap>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0">
      </color_low>
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1">
      </color_high>
      <show_color_scale value="true">
      </show_color_scale>
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="true">
      </show_multiple_chemicals>
      <active_chemical value="a">
      </active_chemical>
      <low value="65">
      </low>
      <high value="120">
      </high>
      <vertical_scale_1D value="30">
      </vertical_scale_1D>
      <vertical_scale_2D value="15">
      </vertical_scale_2D>
      <contour_level value="100">
      </contour_level>
      <cap_contour value="true">
      </cap_contour>
      <invert_contour_cap value="false">
      </invert_contour_cap>
      <use_wireframe value="false">
      </use_wireframe>
      <show_cell_edges value="false">
      </show_cell_edges>
      <show_bounding_box value="true">
      </show_bounding_box>
      <show_chemical_label value="true">
      </show_chemical_label>
      <slice_3D value="true">
      </slice_3D>
      <slice_3D_axis value="z">
      </slice_3D_axis>
      <slice_3D_position value="0.5">
      </slice_3D_position>
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false">
      </show_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="true">
      </color_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <use_image_interpolation value="true">
      </use_image_interpolation>
      <timesteps_per_render value="42">
      </timesteps_per_render>
      <show_phase_plot value="false">
      </show_phase_plot>
      <phase_plot_x_axis value="a">
      </phase_plot_x_axis>
      <phase_plot_y_axis value="b">
      </phase_plot_y_axis>
      <phase_plot_z_axis value="c">
      </phase_plot_z_axis>
      <plot_ab_orthogonally value="false">
      </plot_ab_orthogonally>
    </render_settings>
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 255 0 255 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
